segments.text: Ok so this is the multimodal attachments page for Claude Agent SDK TypeScript on React Native, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, the page says type a question and tap Send, umm, but Send doesn't do anything.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
Moving on to the demo. After typing a question and tapping Send, the message should go out, but the text just stays in the box and nothing happens.
So basically, the composer from the page never sends anything, no message, no reply, and no error either.
That's the problem here, please have a look.
